crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Tax Structuring and Planning
children.blurb: Tax structuring and planning covers the design of legal entities, contracts, financing, and intellectual property ownership across jurisdictions to shape where income, deductions, credits, and gains are recognized.

children.name: Transfer Pricing
children.blurb: Transfer pricing is the set of rules and practices for setting and testing the prices charged in transactions between related entities that operate in different tax jurisdictions.

children.name: Research Credits from Engineering Records
children.blurb: Research credits from engineering records covers the use of engineering artifacts to support claims for research and development tax credits.

children.name: Sales, Use and Value Added Tax
children.blurb: Sales, use, and value added tax are transaction taxes that apply to the transfer of goods and services.

children.name: Audit Defence and Controversy
children.blurb: Audit defence and controversy covers the work of responding to tax authority inquiries, audits, assessments, appeals, and mutual agreement procedures across jurisdictions.

sections.body: Tax and jurisdictional compliance for AI companies is the work of aligning where value is created, where code and models are developed, where customers sit, and where tax authorities expect returns and payments. AI is used now to read contracts, invoices, ledger entries, and engineering records, then flag inconsistencies across entities and periods. It helps build transfer pricing documentation by pulling comparable transactions and intercompany agreements into one view. It can classify transactions for sales, use, and value added tax, and it can trace research and development costs from code commits, tickets, and payroll. It does not replace tax judgment, but it reduces manual reconciliation and makes the paper trail easier to inspect.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The work is partly solved at the data gathering and consistency checking stage. Large language models and rules engines can extract terms from unstructured documents, match them to ledger accounts, and produce first drafts of local files and disclosures. What is not solved is the legal and economic judgment about arm's length pricing, permanent establishment, credit eligibility, and penalty exposure. Tax authorities in different jurisdictions still apply different tests, and an AI system cannot resolve a conflict between two sovereign positions. Audit defence remains human led because it depends on facts, intent, and negotiation. The honest limit is that automation can surface a risk, but it cannot sign a return or accept liability.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: A reader starts with Tax Structuring and Planning for the entity chart, holding company choices, and the logic of where profits are booked. Transfer Pricing goes deeper into intercompany charges for software, data, services, and intellectual property, and it connects to the structuring page because the structure sets the transactions. Research Credits from Engineering Records shows how code repositories, design documents, and time tracking become evidence for credit claims, which matters when a tax authority asks what was actually built. Sales, Use and Value Added Tax handles indirect tax on subscriptions, hardware, and digital services across borders. Audit Defence and Controversy is the end point, where the earlier records become the defence file, and it ties back to every other page because an audit tests the whole chain. The site tracks 219 compliance and regulation pages, and these five pages sit inside that set.
